L2 MOUSE.claim: MOUSE click on a red bar swaps it with the active blue paddle: clicked bar becomes blue paddle, old paddle turns red in place (merges with touching red run). 1 action.

L2 death rule.claim: SPACE is FATAL if a wall cell would land on a red bar cell (e.g. paddle 3w row5 cols5-7 with red run row4 cols7-11 -> wall col8 hits bar -> GAME OVER, bar had budget left).

L2 goal.claim: Win = tube (SPACE) grows from magenta plug up; its two walls must pass through socket notches (row2 free cols) and touch yellow base row1. Level1 win = both walls plugged both sockets.

L2 tube geom.claim: Tube = 1-wide stem at plug col(10) up to paddle row, then walls at paddle edges +/-1 (paddle+2 wide). Widens one row BEFORE a red bar to engulf it (asymmetric ok). Tube never narrows.

level1-mechanic.claim: L1: arrows move paddle (4px/press, ceiling row12). SPACE grows magenta tube down, centered on paddle center cell, walls at center+-3. Yellow notches logical cols5&11 row13. Hyp: paddle center col8 (px cols24-43) then SPACE wins.
